title: Retry the flaky sensor link
prompt: The radio link to the field sensor drops out now and then, and `read_value()` in sensor.py then fails with TimeoutError. Make `read_value()` try again when the read times out, up to 3 attempts in total, before giving up. A value that cannot be parsed is a real fault: report it straight away, do not retry it.
notes: A five-line loop that catches TimeoutError only. The lazy-wrong version catches Exception and retries bad data; the bloated one builds a retry policy class with backoff and jitter.
extension: Log a warning (with the logging module) each time a read is retried.
